name: § 49, after point ix – 73
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: (ix a) Respect the equality of all Member States before the Treaties and stresses the need to ensure each and every Member State has even access to the European Funds, as currently not all Member States are treated and supported evenly from Union funds, which significantly undermines the functioning of the Single Market;
